senses.gloss: (b. h. (b. h. שָׂחָה) to swim. Part. סָחֵי; f. סַחְיָא.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 8:18">Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 18</cite>.—Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>ההן דסָ׳ וכ׳</he> swimming (on the Sabbath).
Ez. XXVI, 4) [to scrape, sweep,] to wash, bathe.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:8">Targ. Lev. XIV, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Y. l. c. <he>עאל מִיסְחֵי וכ׳</he> went bathing with &c. Bab. ib. 141ᵃ <he>מאן דסָחֵי במיא וכ׳</he> he who bathes in the river &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:2">Y. Pes. X, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>סְחָה וצחא</he> had taken a bath and was thirsty. Y. Ter. VII, end, 46ᶜ <he>סְחוּן וכ׳</he> take ye a bath, for your Creator will help you &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>עד דאינון סַחְיָין</he> until they shall have taken a bath.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:9">Ruth R. to II, 19</cite> <he>נחתון מִסְחֵי וכ׳</he> (not <he>מסחו</he>) they went down to bathe &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:30">Targ. Job IX, 30</cite> (Ms. <he>אשתזיג</he>, v. <cite ref="U00593"><he>שְׁזג</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:9">Targ. Lev. XIV, 9</cite> (not <he>ויִסְחֵי</he>); a. fr.—Ruth R. l. c. <he>כי קיימין מַסְחֲיָין יתיה</he> (or <he>מַסְחִין</he>) when they were washing his body.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>עאל אַסְחֵיה</he> (not <cite ref="O00454"><he>אסחי</he></cite>) he went in and scoured him (Mordecai); a. e.
